description:
Keep the card details you need close, even when the card isn't with you.

Holder keeps credit and debit cards, IDs, memberships, loyalty cards, insurance cards, and more in one private place. Stop digging through notes, photos, and messages when you need a number for checkout, travel, or a form.

Add cards faster

Scan a credit or debit card on iPhone or iPad, and Holder fills in the number, name, and expiry date it can read. Check each field before you save, or type the details yourself.

Find the right card fast

Card art and groups make the right card easy to spot. Open it and copy the detail you need.

Private by default

Holder works offline, with no account to create and no bank to link. Card details are stored in Apple Keychain and can sync through iCloud Keychain if you use it. Optional card images are stored in iCloud Documents. Text recognition runs on your device, and camera images are not uploaded to read your card.

Locked when you want it

Lock Holder with Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode. Showing a security code, sharing a card, or deleting one can ask you to confirm it's you again.
promotionalText: Scan a credit or debit card, check the details, and save it. Lock Holder with Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode.
whatsNew:
掃描卡片更可靠了：

• 不會再因混入有效期限中的數字而填入錯誤的卡號。
• 如果無法確定姓名或有效期限是否屬於你的卡片，相應欄位會留空。
• 關閉掃描器後，新增卡片畫面不再隨之關閉，你可以手動輸入資料。

另外修正了新增卡片或瀏覽歡迎畫面時短暫卡頓的問題。
